title: Weapon quality (one qualities.vocab.json entry)
description: One entry of the qualities vocabulary (public/data/canonical/qualities.vocab.json and its schema/vocab/ twin). Before B-219 the vocabulary had no entry schema; validate_registries only checked that a weapon's quality id is a member (ruling f100-b219-card ADDENDUM 1, R-B219C-6). A quality that changes the wielder's OWN roll (the census's ROLL class, brief f100-b219-census) carries its rows here, written per ONE rating: the one reader (lib/shared/qualityRows.js, called by computeWeaponPool) scales them by the weapon's RESOLVED rating (after attachments, R-B1185), an unrated quality reading 1. The rows carry no `applies_to`: the quality's own words ('while using this weapon') are the anchor, and the reader stamps the attack's own skill. They never enter collectPoolMods (a stock and a modified copy of one weapons.json record share a regId). Written by ONE idempotent applier, scripts/canonical/apply_quality_rows.py (overlay_chains, the qualities.vocab.json chain), from scripts/canonical/quality_rows.json. Validator arm L1q.rows.

description_from.description: Blob-retirement D-BR2: a droid variant carries its base quality's text, and names the base here.

pool_mods.description: The quality's dice and automatic symbols at the wielder's attack (R-B219C-6), per ONE rating. The `threat` symbol is ADMITTED here (Inferior, EotE p.156: the wielder's own check; R-B219C-9/-17, the owner wrapper widened to quality rows); a difficulty UPGRADE is refused here as on every talent/item owner (the wrapper's first arm, R-M9S-3), so only species rows carry it. `count_of: {of: rating_deficit, key: brawn | agility}` (R-B219C-7) reads max(0, rating - that characteristic) instead of the rating, and a deficit of 0 drops the row. QUALITY rows refuse `applies_to`, `per_rank`, `condition`, `cost`, `limit`, `cite`, `words` and `floor` (validator L1q.rows): a stored quality row is unconditional; an OFFER (Cumbersome beside a reducer or Burly, R-B219C-8) is the reader's, from its committed trigger table.

roll_numbers.description: A number the app works out at a roll (R-B219C-10): Vicious's `crit_roll_delta` 10 per rating at moment `critical_inflicted`, the Critical roll the wielder INFLICTS. `per_rank: true` (scaled by the resolved rating); no `applies_to` (validator L1q.rows). No surface rolls an inflicted crit yet (a named row for the surfacing mission, R-M9E-7).

spend.description: F-100 M12 QS1 (f100-m12-census-card R-M12C-8/-95; gate table §2; finish line R-M12F-5: the 11 SPEND qualities BECOME spend options): the quality's activations, written per ONE rating (R-B219C-6's form). The spend menu PROPOSES them and the player taps; the engine never spends (R-M12F-5). Its consumer is the spend menu's cost test, spendAfford, which reads `req` unchanged (reader gap R6: today every quality gives the menu text and one cite, no cost). Newly MODELLED (R-M12F-8).

target.description: F-100 M12 QT1 (R-M12C-8/-58/-95): what the quality does to the TARGET's numbers, read off the RESOLVED weapon and the target's own numbers by ONE pure resolver, qualityRows.js `targetRows(weapon, target)`, with a node guard as its consumer in M12. No app surface calls it until the surfacing mission wires a target (reader gap R4: no code computes damage against a target).

target_condition.description: F-100 M12 QT1: the WHOLE entry's rows apply only against this kind of target. The droid variants (stun_damage_droids, vicious_droids) carry their base's rows (written by the applier) under this condition; their text already rides `description_from`.

mode.description: F-100 M12 QM1 (R-M12C-8/-95; R-B219C-5): a way of using the weapon the wielder switches on BEFORE the check, OFFERED and never applied by itself (M8's offer row): Auto-fire's +1 difficulty, Stun setting's Short range and strain damage. Ticked, its rows join the fold and `range_max` caps the band in computeWeaponPool's legality (R-BBL-1). A `spend` row naming this mode is offered only while it is on.

req.description: The price, spend_tables.json's own clause list (ANY ONE entry pays), so spendAfford reads it unchanged. A quality is activated with Advantage or Triumph: `th`/`de` are refused here by the validator (a flaw's currency).

req_add.description: A price that grows with the target: Knockdown's "1 additional [AD] per silhouette beyond 1" (EotE p.156). `per`'s enum holds that one reading; a second needs its own paper.

repeat.description: Absent: once per check. true: as often as it is paid (Auto-fire, Sunder). "rating": up to the weapon's resolved rating (Linked). A number: up to that many.

when.description: On a successful check (hit) or a failed one (Blast's [AD][AD][AD] on a miss, Guided's).

mode.description: The entry's `mode.id`: offered only while that mode is on (Auto-fire: no extra hit without the +1 difficulty, R-B219C-5).

effect.description: What it does, in this project's plain mechanical voice (not the book's prose), for the menu to show. Never applied by the engine. A template: `{field}` prints that `values` field; `{field:noun}` prints the field and its noun, plural when the value is not 1 (`{steps:step}` → "1 step" / "2 steps"), read by the ONE filler lib/shared/qualityRows.js spendRows (ruling f100-surfacing-hub-concept ADDENDUM 7, R2).

values.description: The named numbers `effect` states, so a QS3 row (`spend_effect_set`) can change one by name: Sunder's {steps: 1}, which Sunder (Improved) sets to 2.

reads.description: Every number the effect reads, named so the menu can say what it needs (R-M12C-8).

op.description: soak_ignore: ignore that much soak, never below 0 (Pierce). armor_ignore: ignore that much armour, 1 armour = 10 soak on a personal target (Breach). damage_as: the damage is dealt as `value` instead of wounds, still reduced by soak (Stun Damage, Ion). immune_to: the HOLDER's item ignores the attacker's listed qualities (Cortosis).

per_rating.description: soak_ignore / armor_ignore ONLY, required there: the amount is the weapon's resolved rating.

value.description: damage_as: strain | system_strain. immune_to: the quality ids ignored.

holder.description: immune_to ONLY, required there: which of the DEFENDER's items holds the quality (Cortosis on a weapon ignores Sunder; on armour, the wearer's soak ignores Pierce and Breach).

target_condition.description: F-100 M12 QT1: the row (or entry) applies only against a target of this kind (Ion: vehicles and droids; the droid variants).

offered.description: Always an offer: the wielder chooses before the check (R-M12C-8: the engine proposes, it never chooses).

pool_mods.description: The dice the mode adds to the check while on (Auto-fire's {die: difficulty, direction: add, count: 1}), refusing what a quality row refuses (L1q.rows).

range_max.description: The longest band the check may be made at while on (Stun setting: short); beyond it is BARRED (R-BBL-1).

damage_as.description: While on, the damage is dealt as strain (Stun setting), QT1's damage_as read in the mode.
